title: You Are the Trigger: Speaker-Activated Backdoors
abstract: arXiv:2610.27210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speech models are increasingly used as an interface to AI systems, from transcription tools to voice agents. Existing audio backdoors require an attacker to introduce triggers at inference time. We study a different threat model in which the attacker compromises the model during fine-tuning but has no access to the victim's inference-time inputs. We introduce the Speaker-Activated Backdoor (SAB) setting, in which a target speaker's natural voice serves as the trigger. We develop a two-phase fine-tuning method that first makes speaker identity more accessible and then binds the target speaker to an attacker-chosen payload. Compared with a one-phase baseline with the same training budget, the two-phase method substantially improves selectivity and clean performance, and is especially important for content-dependent attacks. SAB achieves 90.2% and 97.0% backdoor success on Whisper-medium and Parakeet, with false-positive rates of 1.7% and 0

translated_title: 你就是触发器：说话人激活的后门攻击
translated_abstract: 语音模型正日益被用作AI系统的交互接口，涵盖从转录工具到语音智能体等多种应用。现有的音频后门攻击要求攻击者在推理时注入触发器。我们研究了另一种威胁模型：攻击者在微调阶段破坏模型，但无法接触受害者在推理时的输入。我们提出了说话人激活后门（Speaker-Activated Backdoor, SAB）设定，其中目标说话人的自然声音即可充当触发器。我们开发了一种两阶段微调方法，首先使说话人身份特征更易被模型捕捉，然后将目标说话人与攻击者选定的恶意载荷绑定。在相同训练预算下，与单阶段基线相比，两阶段方法显著提升了攻击选择性和干净样本性能，对内容依赖型攻击尤为重要。SAB在Whisper-medium和Parakeet模型上分别实现了90.2%和97.0%的后门攻击成功率，误报率仅为1.7%和0（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 提出说话人激活后门（SAB）新威胁模型：攻击者只需在微调阶段植入后门，即可让目标说话人的自然声音成为触发器，通过两阶段微调方法在Whisper-medium和Parakeet上实现90%以上的攻击成功率且误报率极低。
en_tdlr: Introduces the Speaker-Activated Backdoor (SAB) threat model, where an attacker poisons a model only during fine-tuning so that a target speaker's natural voice serves as the trigger, achieving over 90% attack success with very low false positives on Whisper-medium and Parakeet through a two-phase fine-tuning method.
